room.hall.title: Sage's Hall
room.hall.description: A quiet hall lined with shelves of curios.
item.ring.room: A dull [[ring|ring]] lies on a shelf.
item.ring.description: A plain, dull band of grey metal.
item.ring.description_known: A ring of keen sight. The world looks sharper through it.
npc.sage.description: An old sage who knows every trinket by its feel.
dialogue.sage.prompt: "Show me what you carry," says the sage.
narration.sage.ask: The sage turns the ring in the light. "A ring of keen sight," she says.
